nodes.name: Tao (Dao)
nodes.essence: The way before definition: source, course, and unpossessed order.
nodes.shadow: The nameless way is reduced to a doctrine, brand, or answer.

nodes.name: Wu — Not-Having
nodes.essence: Absence as an active condition: what is not possessed, imposed, or occupied.
nodes.shadow: Absence is mistaken for nihilism or neglect.

nodes.name: Being (You)
nodes.essence: Manifest presence: the named, formed, available face of reality.
nodes.shadow: Form mistakes itself for the whole.

nodes.name: Non-Being (Wu)
nodes.essence: The unmanifest pole from which forms become possible and to which they cease.
nodes.shadow: The unmanifest is romanticized as superior to embodied life.

nodes.name: One
nodes.essence: Undivided coherence before polarity, not sameness imposed upon difference.
nodes.shadow: Unity becomes conformity.

nodes.name: Two
nodes.essence: Differentiation through which relation, polarity, and change become visible.
nodes.shadow: Difference hardens into opposition.

nodes.name: Ten Thousand Things
nodes.essence: The inexhaustible multiplicity of beings, events, names, and relations.
nodes.shadow: Multiplicity becomes noise, inventory, or consumption.

nodes.name: Return
nodes.essence: Reversal is the movement of the Way: outward unfolding bends back toward root.
nodes.shadow: Return becomes nostalgia or forced restoration.

nodes.name: Emptiness
nodes.essence: Usable capacity created by what is not filled.
nodes.shadow: Emptiness becomes sterility, dissociation, or aesthetic purity.

nodes.name: Mystery (Xuan)
nodes.essence: The shared depth where named and unnamed remain one source under different aspects.
nodes.shadow: Mystery is used to conceal weak claims or claim secret authority.

nodes.name: Yin
nodes.essence: The receptive, inward, cooling, darkening tendency within change.
nodes.shadow: Receptivity collapses into passivity or concealment.

nodes.name: Yang
nodes.essence: The active, outward, warming, brightening tendency within change.
nodes.shadow: Initiative becomes domination or exposure without shelter.

nodes.name: Stillness
nodes.essence: The capacity to cease motion long enough for pattern and limit to appear.
nodes.shadow: Stillness hardens into refusal or numbness.

nodes.name: Movement
nodes.essence: The activation through which conditions meet, separate, and transform.
nodes.shadow: Motion becomes agitation, flight, or compulsion.

nodes.name: Receptivity
nodes.essence: The strength to be shaped by contact without surrendering discernment.
nodes.shadow: Openness becomes indiscriminate absorption.

nodes.name: Initiative
nodes.essence: The force that begins, names, or enters before conditions organize themselves.
nodes.gift: Agency, courage, and generative first motion.
nodes.shadow: Beginning becomes conquest or attachment to authorship.

nodes.name: Soft
nodes.essence: What yields, bends, or enters without losing continuity.
nodes.shadow: Softness avoids necessary resistance or truth.

nodes.name: Hard
nodes.essence: What holds shape, resists pressure, cuts, or bears weight.
nodes.shadow: Strength becomes brittleness, domination, or injury.

nodes.name: Dark
nodes.essence: The concealed, cooling field where forms withdraw from immediate view.
nodes.gift: Privacy, gestation, and relief from display.
nodes.shadow: Concealment protects deception or fear.

nodes.name: Light
nodes.essence: The revealing, warming field in which distinctions become visible.
nodes.shadow: Illumination becomes surveillance, certainty, or glare.

nodes.name: Valley
nodes.essence: Low receptive form that gathers flows, relation, and fertility.
nodes.shadow: Lowliness becomes self-erasure or accumulated burden.

nodes.name: Mountain
nodes.essence: Concentrated stillness: boundary, endurance, stopping, and obstructive mass.
nodes.shadow: Boundary becomes refusal, isolation, or obstacle.

nodes.name: Wood (Mu)
nodes.essence: Rising, branching life that seeks room, direction, and flexible extension.
nodes.shadow: Growth becomes impatience, invasion, or frustrated anger.

nodes.name: Fire
nodes.essence: Radiant transformation that warms, reveals, attaches, consumes, and spreads.
nodes.gift: Warmth, visibility, connection, and rapid change.
nodes.shadow: Illumination clings to appearances; warmth becomes hunger.

nodes.name: Earth (Tu)
nodes.essence: Centering transformation that receives, composts, nourishes, and redistributes.
nodes.shadow: Care becomes worry, overholding, or refusal to differentiate.

nodes.name: Metal (Jin)
nodes.essence: Contracting clarity that forms boundaries, condenses value, and releases what is finished.
nodes.shadow: Precision becomes grief-bound rigidity, judgment, or severance.

nodes.name: Water
nodes.essence: Yielding power that descends, nourishes, seeks the low place, and reshapes resistance.
nodes.shadow: Yielding becomes evasion; depth becomes danger or concealment.

nodes.name: Qian — Heaven
nodes.essence: Unbroken creative force: initiating, enduring, and responsible for what it sets in motion.
nodes.shadow: Strength becomes command, pride, or action without receptivity.

nodes.name: Kun — Earth
nodes.essence: Broken receptive force: bearing, nourishing, and completing without claiming authorship.
nodes.shadow: Service becomes self-erasure, inertia, or indiscriminate compliance.

nodes.name: Zhen — Thunder
nodes.essence: Arousing shock: the first decisive movement that breaks stillness.
nodes.gift: Courage, beginning, and release from inertia.
nodes.shadow: Shock becomes panic, impulsiveness, or repeated disruption.

nodes.name: Xun — Wind / Wood
nodes.essence: Gentle penetration: influence that enters by continuity, adaptation, and repeated contact.
nodes.shadow: Gentleness becomes indecision, insinuation, or invisible pressure.

nodes.name: Kan — Water
nodes.essence: A true current carried through danger: depth, ravine, repetition, and practiced passage.
nodes.gift: Depth, adaptability, and skill learned by repetition.
nodes.shadow: Danger fascinates; depth becomes secrecy or habitual crisis.

nodes.name: Li — Fire
nodes.essence: Illumination that depends on what it clings to: radiance, discernment, and attachment.
nodes.gift: Clarity, culture, warmth, and articulate relation.
nodes.shadow: Brightness clings to image, validation, or consuming fuel.

nodes.name: Gen — Mountain
nodes.essence: Keeping still at the proper limit: stopping, boundary, completion, and renewed beginning.
nodes.shadow: Stillness becomes obstruction, stubbornness, or isolation.

nodes.name: Dui — Lake
nodes.essence: Joyous exchange at an open surface: pleasure, speech, reflection, and mutual influence.
nodes.gift: Joy, conversation, ease, and shared refreshment.
nodes.shadow: Pleasure flatters, leaks, or avoids necessary depth.

nodes.name: Wu Wei
nodes.essence: Action free of coercive strain: responding so closely to conditions that force is not wasted.
nodes.shadow: Non-forcing is confused with passivity, neglect, or spiritual superiority.

nodes.name: De — Immanent Power
nodes.essence: The particular efficacy by which a being follows the Way as itself.
nodes.shadow: Virtue becomes reputation, moral display, or a claim to superiority.

nodes.name: Ziran — Self-So
nodes.essence: The spontaneous suchness by which things unfold from their own conditions, not an external mold.
nodes.shadow: Spontaneity excuses impulse, habit, or avoidance of craft.

nodes.name: Pu — Simplicity
nodes.essence: Original simplicity: unadorned sufficiency before value is inflated by display and division.
nodes.gift: Directness, sufficiency, and freedom from display.
nodes.shadow: Simplicity becomes naïveté, anti-intellectualism, or purity theater.

nodes.name: Uncarved Block
nodes.essence: Potential before imposed use: a form not yet narrowed to one identity or function.
nodes.gift: Adaptability, latent capacity, and freedom from premature definition.
nodes.shadow: Unformed potential becomes an excuse never to commit.

nodes.name: Empty Vessel
nodes.essence: Usefulness created by the shaped absence within a form.
nodes.shadow: Emptiness becomes vacancy, self-negation, or ornamental minimalism.

nodes.name: Valley Spirit
nodes.essence: Receptive generativity that remains low, open, and inexhaustibly available.
nodes.gift: Fertility, continuity, and power without display.
nodes.shadow: Receptivity is fetishized as endless availability or gendered submission.

nodes.name: Returning
nodes.essence: The lived act of noticing deviation and turning back before distance becomes destiny.
nodes.shadow: Return becomes self-punishment, regression, or obsessive checking.

nodes.name: Yielding
nodes.essence: Responsive giving-way that preserves continuity while redirecting force.
nodes.gift: Resilience, diplomacy, and survival without direct contest.
nodes.shadow: Yielding becomes appeasement, collapse, or fear of necessary conflict.

nodes.name: Flow
nodes.essence: Continuous responsive movement through changing constraints.
nodes.shadow: Flow becomes aimlessness, avoidance of commitment, or romanticized ease.

nodes.name: Still Point
nodes.essence: A relative center of quiet within motion from which changing directions can be perceived.
nodes.shadow: Centeredness becomes detachment, control, or refusal to be affected.

nodes.name: Center
nodes.essence: The relational middle where forces can be integrated without being flattened.
nodes.shadow: The center claims neutrality while hiding its power.

nodes.name: Threshold
nodes.essence: The charged interval where one condition has ended but another is not yet established.
nodes.shadow: Liminality is prolonged to avoid commitment or romanticized as inherently profound.

nodes.name: Root
nodes.essence: Hidden anchoring through reciprocal contact with the ground that feeds and resists.
nodes.gift: Grounding, nourishment, continuity, and unseen relation.
nodes.shadow: Rootedness becomes entrenchment, possession, or hidden extraction.

nodes.name: Branch
nodes.essence: Differentiated reach: one source exploring several directions without ceasing to be related.
nodes.shadow: Branching becomes distraction, hierarchy, or unchecked proliferation.

nodes.name: Gate
nodes.essence: A selective opening that regulates passage between fields.
nodes.shadow: Guardianship becomes exclusion, secrecy, or control of others’ movement.

nodes.name: Breath (Qi image)
nodes.essence: Rhythmic exchange that joins inner and outer without making them identical.
nodes.shadow: Breath is mystified into a cure-all or used to bypass material conditions.

nodes.name: River
nodes.essence: A path made by moving relation: source, bank, obstacle, confluence, and destination continually reshape one another.
nodes.gift: Continuity, adaptation, connection, and carried memory.
nodes.shadow: The current carries contamination, cuts banks, or makes inevitability of its own habit.

nodes.name: Rain
nodes.essence: Distributed descent that nourishes, reveals saturation, and links sky to ground.
nodes.shadow: Blessing language ignores flood, timing, inequity, or damaged ground.

nodes.name: Cloud
nodes.essence: Form held temporarily in suspension: gathering, obscuring, carrying, and preparing release.
nodes.gift: Incubation, shade, transport, and approaching change.
nodes.shadow: Ambiguity becomes evasion, mood becomes authority, or gathering never releases.

nodes.name: Mist
nodes.essence: Partial visibility that softens fixed edges and makes distance uncertain.
nodes.gift: Gentleness, patience, and freedom from premature certainty.
nodes.shadow: Ambiguity shelters projection, avoidance, or covert action.

nodes.name: Bamboo
nodes.essence: Hollow-jointed resilience: flexible because strength is segmented and the center is open.
nodes.gift: Resilience, growth, community, and disciplined emptiness.
nodes.shadow: Flexibility performs grace while damage accumulates at the joints.

nodes.name: Pine
nodes.essence: Endurance through seasons: conserving life without pretending winter is summer.
nodes.shadow: Endurance becomes pride in deprivation or refusal of help.

nodes.name: Crane
nodes.essence: Measured elevation: patient stillness that becomes precise movement and long passage.
nodes.shadow: Elevation becomes aloofness, omen-making, or superiority.

nodes.name: Turtle
nodes.essence: Protected longevity: carrying a boundary while moving at the pace continuity requires.
nodes.gift: Patience, protection, continuity, and measured response.
nodes.shadow: Protection becomes withdrawal, fatalism, or false claims of prediction.

nodes.name: Dragon
nodes.essence: Latent transformative potency moving between depth, cloud, rain, and emergence.
nodes.gift: Transformation, vitality, scale-shifting, and catalytic presence.
nodes.shadow: Power becomes grandiosity, spectacle, or borrowed cultural exoticism.

nodes.name: Tiger
nodes.essence: Focused boundary power: embodied presence, decisive protection, and dangerous appetite.
nodes.gift: Courage, protection, precision, and embodied limit.
nodes.shadow: Protection becomes threat, domination, or predation.

nodes.name: Moon
nodes.essence: Borrowed light and rhythmic change: visibility that waxes, wanes, and depends on relation.
nodes.gift: Reflection, rhythm, inward vision, and patience.
nodes.shadow: Indirectness becomes projection, secrecy, or dependence on another’s light.

nodes.name: Sun
nodes.essence: Direct radiance that reveals, warms, organizes rhythm, and can scorch.
nodes.gift: Clarity, vitality, rhythm, and public presence.
nodes.shadow: Brightness becomes exposure, centrality, or demand for constant positivity.

nodes.name: Star
nodes.essence: Distant orientation: a small steady relation that helps position without dictating the path.
nodes.shadow: Guidance becomes destiny, abstraction, or escape from local evidence.

nodes.name: Seed
nodes.essence: Concentrated future held in a protected form, dependent on conditions it cannot command.
nodes.gift: Readiness, inheritance, patience, and compact possibility.
nodes.shadow: Potential is romanticized without regard for soil, season, or viability.

nodes.name: Sprout
nodes.essence: Vulnerable emergence: life crossing from protected potential into exposed growth.
nodes.gift: Courage, renewal, learning, and responsive beginning.
nodes.shadow: Newness demands protection from all friction or seeks praise before rooting.

nodes.name: Blossom
nodes.essence: Brief visible opening that invites exchange and cannot be kept.
nodes.gift: Beauty, invitation, recognition, and timely openness.
nodes.shadow: Appearance is confused with maturity, worth, or guaranteed fruit.

nodes.name: Fruit
nodes.essence: Ripened consequence: nourishment and seed carried together at the end of a growth cycle.
nodes.shadow: Outcome becomes possession, status, or proof of personal control.

nodes.name: Decay
nodes.essence: Form loosening into smaller relations so stored material can re-enter the world.
nodes.shadow: Loss is aestheticized or used to excuse preventable neglect.

nodes.name: Compost
nodes.essence: Collaborative transformation of discarded matter into fertile, altered ground.
nodes.gift: Regeneration, integration, and value recovered from endings.
nodes.shadow: “Everything is useful” denies grief, toxicity, or what must be discarded safely.

nodes.name: Silence
nodes.essence: An interval without imposed speech in which subtler signals can appear.
nodes.gift: Listening, rest, privacy, and unforced understanding.
nodes.shadow: Silence conceals harm, withholds needed truth, or imposes exclusion.

nodes.name: Sound
nodes.essence: Vibration made shareable: expression traveling through a medium and altering what receives it.
nodes.gift: Communication, warning, music, and mutual attunement.
nodes.shadow: Expression becomes noise, performance, manipulation, or echo.

nodes.name: Shadow
nodes.essence: Evidence of relation between light, form, and position: neither substance nor mere absence.
nodes.gift: Depth, contrast, privacy, and recognition of what a self-image excludes.
nodes.shadow: The unknown is treated as evil, or projection is mistaken for fact.

nodes.name: Mirror
nodes.essence: Reflective relation that reveals a view, reverses it, and never contains the whole thing reflected.
nodes.gift: Self-recognition, feedback, comparison, and reversal of view.
nodes.shadow: Reflection becomes vanity, surveillance, imitation, or mistaken identity.
